title: Quiet Night Rain | 1 Hour of Gentle Rain Ambience for Rest & Focus
description:
A quiet illustrated window, gentle night rain, and one uninterrupted hour to unwind. This original, softly varying synthesized rain soundscape has no music or spoken voice. Use it as a calm background for reading, studying, resting, or a slow evening.

The visuals are an original procedural illustration and the rain is synthesized; this is not a field recording. Created for Quiet Hours Relaxing Sounds.

#RainAmbience #RelaxingSounds #QuietHours
recording_credits: Original procedural illustration and synthesized rain soundscape created for Quiet Hours Relaxing Sounds using Python and FFmpeg. No field recordings, music, or third-party media used.
